title: Through the Wall
blurb: Your apartment building has walls like paper, and your boyfriend lives in the unit right next door. Late at night, a text lights up your phone. "You're still up. I can hear you breathing through the wall. ...If you don't want this, put your phone down. If you do, do exactly what I say."

P.c: Lie back in bed with a blanket or towel up to your chest, tissues within reach. Earbuds in if you have them, or keep the volume low. Hands on your stomach.
t: You read it. Don't text back. If you change your mind, just close it. Any time.
No blanket? A towel or a hoodie over you works too.
Walls this thin, if you make a sound, I'll hear it. So will the hallway.
So from here on, we stay quiet.

G.c: Under the blanket, stroke over your clit through your clothes with two fingers, slowly, with the beat.
t: Can you hear the beat? Match that.
Over your clothes. Your hand stays outside for now.
Your breathing just changed. I can tell, even through the wall.
If the screen says "Footsteps," stop right away.
If it gets to be too much, hit "I'm close" below.

Y.c: Keep your fingers there and stroke at half the speed.
t: Slowly.
Hot, even through the fabric, isn't it?

R.c: Footsteps. Put your hands back on your stomach and stay still.
t: ...Someone's in the hallway.
Breathe quietly. Don't let the bed creak.
...They're gone. If you're too sensitive now, stay around the edges from here.

X.c: Hands off, right now, back on your stomach. Breathe slowly until it passes.
t: Through your clothes, and already?
Not a sound out of you. Good girl.
Once you're calm, we'll keep going.

G.c: Wet your fingers with spit, or lotion if you have it. Slip your hand into your underwear under the blanket, and stroke from your entrance up to your clit with the beat.
t: You can really touch yourself now.
Bottom to top. Slowly.
Fingers gliding easier now?
If the bed creaks, I'll hear it. Keep your hips still.
If it's getting close, hit "I'm close" below.

Y.c: Keep your fingers there and stroke at half the speed.
t: Slowly.
I'm lying just as still on my side of the wall.

R.c: Footsteps. Take your hand out of your underwear, rest it on your stomach, and stay still.
t: ...Someone's heading down to the laundry room.
Don't hold your breath. In normally, out normally.
...Okay. They went back inside.

X.c: Take your hand out of your underwear and rest it on your stomach. Stay still until it passes.
t: That was close.
And you're still keeping quiet. I'm impressed.
I'll wait until you're calm.

G.c: Wet your fingers with spit, or lotion if you have it. Reach into your underwear, and circle your clit with your middle finger, one small circle per beat. Too sensitive? Circle around it.
t: Small. Keep that pace.
No pressing hard. Just trace it.
Let your shoulders drop.
I'm counting your breaths through the wall, {n}.
If you can't take much more, hit "I'm close" below.

Y.c: Slow your circles to half the speed.
t: Slowly.
Not yet.

R.c: Footsteps. Fingers off, both hands on your stomach.
t: ...Someone's walking right past your door.
Stay still. Don't move the blanket.
...It's okay. They're gone.

X.c: Fingers off, both hands on your stomach. Breathe deep until it passes.
t: That was a close one.
You stopped. That's my girl.
Once you've calmed down, a little more.

G.c: Wet your middle finger and slide it in slowly, thumb on your clit, moving a little with the beat. Or just press at your entrance. Stop if it hurts.
t: No need to go deep. Stay close to the entrance. If going in isn't your thing, pressing there is plenty.
Keep your thumb on your clit.
If a sound's about to slip out, pull the blanket up over your mouth.
Is the bed creaking? Keep it small.
When you hit your limit, press "I'm close" below.

Y.c: Keep your fingers where they are and move at half the speed.
t: Slowly.
Feel that little flutter?

R.c: Footsteps. If your finger's inside, take it out. Both hands on your stomach.
t: ...Someone else is coming up the stairs.
Breathe quietly. ...You're doing it.
They're gone. Almost there now.

X.c: If your finger's inside, take it out. Both hands on your stomach, and wait until it passes.
t: That was right on the edge, wasn't it?
And still not a sound. Good.
Stay like that until you're calm.

G.c: Hand inside your underwear, rub your clit with two fingers, a little faster, with the beat.
t: It's faster now. Keep up.
Your shoulders are tensing up.
Not yet. Not until I count.
The hallway's gone quiet.
If it's too close, hit "I'm close" below.

Y.c: Keep your fingers there and slow to half the speed.
t: Slowly.
Almost.

R.c: Fingers off. Take three deep breaths.
t: You did so well. If you're too sensitive, stay around the edges.
I'll count you down at the end.
Just wait right there.

X.c: Fingers off. Take three deep breaths and wait until it passes.
t: All this way, and you still stopped.
I'll count you down at the end.
Once you've settled, we'll finish.

build.c: Touch yourself however feels best, with the beat. Don't stop until the counting starts.
t: This is the last part.
Muffle any sound in the blanket.
I'll count down from 5. At 0, that's your cue to come.

count.c: Keep touching and hold on while {m} counts down from 5. At 0, that's your cue to come.

allow.c: You can come now. Keep going. When you do, hit "I came" below.
t: Now.
Keep it in the blanket.
I heard every breath, {n}.
Good job.
Pull your blanket back up. You can fall asleep just like that.
Again soon. Through the wall.
...Did you just come?
It's okay. Nobody in the hallway heard.
Next time, wait for my word.

allow.title: Not a Sound
allow.line: You stayed silent and made it all the way to the end.
